title: The puzzle of the Sun's energy
description: Why burning and gravitational contraction could not explain the Sun, how Eddington in 1920 used Aston's helium measurement to propose hydrogen fusion, and an estimate of the Sun's lifetime with clearly stated assumptions.

sources.title: A. S. Eddington, 'The Internal Constitution of the Stars', address in Cardiff, 24 August 1920, Nature 106, 14–20 (1920); text read from the University of Colorado course copy
sources.note: Quotations used: 'vast reservoir of energy', 'sub-atomic energy', Aston's helium result, '1 part in 120'.
